name: Reaping Slash / Reaping Slash A / Reaping Slash R

values.meaning: Physical Damage (per instance, dash or swing)
Darkin Slayer Bonus damage per hit (as Rhaast)
values.quote: {{as|65% AD}} {{as|(+ 6% {{as|(+ {{fd|3.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|physical damage}} with each hit
values.binNote: Wiki's 65% is stated as plain 'AD' while the flat term (KaynQ#DarkinFlatDamage) computes 0.65 x ad, matching; the percent-health term reads SlayerBaseMaxHPDamage and the TOOLTIPONLY per-100-AD coefficient.

mechanics.claim: Kayn dashes, dealing damage to enemies he passes through, then swings dealing the same damage again to nearby enemies - two separate damage instances.
mechanics.quote: dashes in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies he passes through. He then swings his scythe, dealing the same damage to nearby enemies.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield blocks only one of the two damage instances (dash or slash), not both.
mechanics.quote: Spell shields will block only a single instance of damage - either the dash or the slash.

mechanics.claim: If the dash is interrupted, the swing (second damage instance) does not occur.
mechanics.quote: If the dash is interrupted, Kayn will not swing his scythe.

mechanics.claim: Both instances of the ability deal an additional 40 bonus physical damage against minions and monsters (not against champions/the dummy).
mechanics.quote: Both instances of ''Reaping Slash'' deal {{as|40 '''bonus''' physical damage}} against minions and monsters.

mechanics.claim: The swing's animation has a 0.25-second lockout before the next action.
mechanics.quote: The swing's animation has a {{fd|0.25}}-second lockout time.

mechanics.claim: Other abilities can be queued during the cast of Reaping Slash.
mechanics.quote: Other abilities can be queued while casting ''Reaping Slash''.

mechanics.claim: As Rhaast (Darkin), the ability's damage is entirely replaced by AD and target-max-health-based damage instead of the base bonus-AD-scaling damage.
mechanics.quote: ''Reaping Slash's'' damage is modified to deal {{as|65% AD}} {{as|(+ 6% ... of the target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|physical damage}} with each hit
